goal: Predictively prefill compact blocks with missing transactions bounded by TCP window limits
Avoid extra GETBLOCKTXN round-trips to speed up block propagation and lower orphan risk
agreement: Broad concept approval for simplicity and backward compatibility (josibake, 0xB10C, ismaelsadeeq, murchandamus)
Verified by live telemetry and test suite runs (m4ycon, s00ly)
Objections around use-after-free, logging, and unneeded syscalls resolved (andrewtoth, 0xB10C)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it substantially speeds up compact block propagation across the network
Reconstruction without an extra round-trip rose from 56.9% to 89.7% in live tests

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it adds cross-platform TCP window inspection helpers across major OSes
Utility expansion is tailored specifically to bound prefill sizes rather than broad use
